tools.name: pixl_readiness
tools.description: Read local installation/runtime facts and explicitly supplied host observations. Static files do not prove a loaded specialist; tool visibility does not prove authentication. No provider probes or writes.

installation.description: Installation directory: absolute, or relative to the configured consumer root.

tools.name: pixl_review_context
tools.description: Read exact saved candidate or family criteria, current verdict IDs, semantic binding_hash and canonical state_hash before explicit review. Family creation status is separate from current acceptance. Optional result_path saves the exact full JSON under a fresh project-relative path and returns a compact path/hash summary.

tools.name: pixl_candidate_review
tools.description: Retain explicit specialist observations and criterion judgments for a saved candidate or family. Derive evidence bindings; optionally nominate or complete through existing checks. Retry the identical review ID/payload with current state_hash after interruption. No provider action or automatic visual judgment. Optional result_path saves the exact full JSON under a fresh project-relative path and returns a compact path/hash summary.

expect.description: Current canonical production state hash from pixl_validate.hash or pixl_review_context.state_hash; not a PLAR/file/binding hash.

tools.name: pixl_production_plan
tools.description: Author connected sample/production stages and collective delivery from reviewed JSON using existing contracts, baseline and choices. Recover PLAR links on identical retries. No execution or acceptance.

expect.description: Current canonical production state hash from pixl_validate.hash or pixl_review_context.state_hash; not a PLAR/file/binding hash.

tools.name: pixl_stage_prepare
tools.description: Bind exact reviewed accepted upstream candidates to a planned stage and prepare its durable provider request. Identical retries recover saved intent; no dispatch or acceptance.

expect.description: Current canonical production state hash from pixl_validate.hash or pixl_review_context.state_hash; not a PLAR/file/binding hash.

tools.name: pixl_plar_handoff
tools.description: Save an exact selected-production continuation with agent-authored details. view=caller returns bounded assignment, files, issues and integration observations beside derived state and exact detail/resume references; default receipt unchanged. No acceptance or provider action. Optional result_path saves the exact full JSON under a fresh project-relative path and returns a compact path/hash summary.

requirements_hash.description: Selected semantic requirements digest from pixl_plar_read.requirements_hash; not the PLAR file hash.

expect.description: Current production.continuation.state_hash from selected pixl_plar_read; not the PLAR file hash.

tools.name: pixl_request_review
tools.description: Read exact candidate or connected-plan criteria and source excerpts. For connected plans, view=changes plus against_plan gives a concise structural comparison, retained choices, review attention and exact full-report links. Default complete report is unchanged. Optional comparison checks identity/coverage, never meaning or acceptance. Optional result_path saves the exact full JSON under a fresh project-relative path and returns a compact path/hash summary.

tools.name: pixl_retain_library
tools.description: Retain exact library S-source bytes for a project before a kit update, or recover them from its original kit. Keeps state and receipts unchanged; no new proof or provider action.

expect.description: Current canonical production state hash from pixl_validate.hash or pixl_review_context.state_hash; not a PLAR/file/binding hash.

tools.name: pixl_plar_read
tools.description: Read project asset requirements, source drift and update impact; select asset_id for current production links, pending jobs and next actions.

tools.name: pixl_plar_prepare
tools.description: Prepare a selected asset from reviewed request/criteria and discovered provider schema. Retains the candidate plan and durable job, links the allocation, and resumes identical calls. Explicit revise plus expect appends a reviewed generation after pending work is resolved. No dispatch or art acceptance.

requirements_hash.description: Selected semantic requirements digest from pixl_plar_read.requirements_hash; not the PLAR file hash.

expect.description: Current canonical production state hash from pixl_validate.hash or pixl_review_context.state_hash; not a PLAR/file/binding hash.

tools.name: pixl_plar_save
tools.description: Save a PLAR requirements document with expected file hash (new to create); retain previous bytes and bind new source paths. No provider call.

expect.description: Current PLAR file byte SHA-256 from pixl_plar_read.hash, or new for first save.

tools.name: pixl_validate
tools.description: Validate PIXL state, record bindings and local file hashes.

tools.name: pixl_context
tools.description: Retrieve complete task context (default; fail rather than truncate byte budget), or view=authoring for current contracts, literal criteria, source retrieval links, nominees and pending jobs without proof/history payloads. Authoring is an index, not acceptance. Optional result_path saves the exact full JSON under a fresh project-relative path and returns a compact path/hash summary.

tools.name: pixl_ready
tools.description: List open tasks whose prerequisites are completed and whose tagged PLAR selections remain current.

tools.name: pixl_impact
tools.description: Find records transitively depending on a changed ID.

tools.name: pixl_init
tools.description: Initialize a local PIXL store with explicitly unconfirmed intake defaults.

tools.name: pixl_intake
tools.description: Initialize a PX2 project with a brief and no invented style or production decisions.

tools.name: pixl_task_complete
tools.description: Nominate explicit already-reviewed candidates and complete their PX2 task. Requires every saved criterion passed and provider attempts terminal; creates no acceptance evidence or remote action.

expect.description: Current canonical production state hash from pixl_validate.hash or pixl_review_context.state_hash; not a PLAR/file/binding hash.

tools.name: pixl_workflow
tools.description: Inspect PX2 intake, planned outputs, candidate verdicts, blockers and next ready tasks. No acceptance or remote side effect.

tools.name: pixl_inspection
tools.description: Verify retained inspection and reviews. With packet_id and view_ids, deliver selected PNG image blocks with exact payload dimensions and hashes for viewing. Read-only; no artistic or engine acceptance.

tools.name: pixl_inspection_prepare
tools.description: Retain saved candidate/reference bytes, native and integer-nearest views, and measurements using the expected state hash. No verdict, nomination, task completion or remote action.

expect.description: Current canonical production state hash from pixl_validate.hash or pixl_review_context.state_hash; not a PLAR/file/binding hash.

tools.name: pixl_inspection_review
tools.description: Retain explicit caller viewing observations and criterion verdicts against a prepared packet using the expected hash. Does not establish actual host viewing, nominate the candidate, complete the task or execute an engine.

expect.description: Current canonical production state hash from pixl_validate.hash or pixl_review_context.state_hash; not a PLAR/file/binding hash.

tools.name: pixl_family
tools.description: Verify retained family files and report baseline, member selection, destination requirements, pending jobs and drift. No acceptance or remote action. Optional result_path saves the exact full JSON under a fresh project-relative path and returns a compact path/hash summary.

tools.name: pixl_family_snapshot
tools.description: Copy selected local family files into a retained delivery candidate using the expected state hash. Does not nominate or accept it, change task state, or execute remotely. Optional result_path saves the exact full JSON under a fresh project-relative path and returns a compact path/hash summary.

expect.description: Current canonical production state hash from pixl_validate.hash or pixl_review_context.state_hash; not a PLAR/file/binding hash.
